outcome_evidence: docker images → display-server:latest (167MB) built; docker compose config resolves service, port 127.0.0.1:8001->8001, external shared-net
docker run --rm --entrypoint sh display-server:latest -c 'pip list' → fastapi 0.139.2, uvicorn 0.51.0, httpx 0.28.1, authlib 1.7.2, Jinja2 3.1.6, Python 3.13.16
docker compose up -d with shipped .env → logs: httpx.ConnectError SSL CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED at /auth/signin; 'Application startup failed. Exiting.' (placeholder external Biletado API)
docker run display-server:latest with valid env against mock backend → logs: 'Application startup complete.', 'Uvicorn running on http://0.0.0.0:8001', 'Updated bookings cache.'
curl http://localhost:8001/resources/Room-A → HTTP 200 with rendered HTML containing 'Raumübersicht' and 'Room-A'

assessment_summary: I inspected the pre-checked-out repo at /workspace (commit fccc32f), the Dockerfile, requirements.txt, docker-compose.yml, the copied .env, the built image, and the rendered templates/source. I confirmed the image was built from python:3.13-slim and contains all dependencies pinned in requirements.txt at the exact versions. I then started the installation via `docker compose up -d`, which reproduced the documented behavior: with placeholder .env credentials the Uvicorn lifespan fails at the external Biletado signin URL (SSL cert error / startup failed), an inherent external-dependency condition noted in the guide rather than an installation defect. To obtain behavioral evidence of the software being operational, I ran the existing built image against a temporary mock Biletado backend on the shared-net network using only docker run env overrides (no files edited, no dependencies installed, no artifacts built). The service completed startup, fetched data, and served the expected HTML at /resources/Room-A (HTTP 200, 'Raumübersicht'), /resources?ids=Room-A|Room-B (HTTP 200, both resources), and /static/logo.png (HTTP 200). Temporary containers/images were removed afterward, restoring the original state. Limitations: full end-to-end operation against the real Biletado API could not be tested because valid tenant credentials/reachable booking platform are external prerequisites unavailable here; verification relied on a mock consistent with the API contract used by the source.
